snippet.title: Glasshouse - Official Pre-Alpha Playtest Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Here's your look at the Glasshouse playtest announcement trailer for this upcoming thriller-driven, turn-based CRPG set in a locked-down condominium on the brink of a world war. Glasshouse will be available on PC, and a Steam Playtest is out now.
